_about: Lucky Monkey gameplay tuning. Edit, then `tools/deploy.sh data` (seconds, no rebuild). Missing keys fall back to the built-in copy.

ddos.name: DDoS stampede
ddos.symptom: Requests x40. A herd of 9,000 monkeys is hammering one endpoint. Spills onto neighbours once the node falls over.

worm.name: Worm
worm.symptom: Unknown process copying itself over every API connection. Crawls to a neighbour each time its timer runs out.

forecast.text: A worm signature is spreading in the wild and this node is unpatched.

disparity.name: Replica disparity
disparity.symptom: Replica checksums disagree: two copies, two different banana counts. Data is lost if it goes down.

deploy.name: Bad deploy
deploy.symptom: v2.4 went out and the error rate is 30%. No schema change: v2.3 is still compatible.

forecast.text: A deploy of v2.4 is scheduled. Push it through a canary first and a bad build never reaches everyone.

migration.name: Bad deploy + migration
migration.symptom: v2.4 migrated the schema and the error rate is 30%. v2.3 can't read the new tables.

forecast.text: A deploy of v2.4 is scheduled. Push it through a canary first and a bad build never reaches everyone.

lightning.name: Lightning strike
lightning.symptom: Lightning hit the rack. The primary power supply is dead.

cert.name: Expired certificate
cert.symptom: TLS handshakes failing. The certificate expired.

forecast.text: The TLS certificate is about to expire. Renew it before the countdown ends.

leak.name: Memory leak
leak.symptom: Banana heap growing 2 GB/min, swap is thrashing. Nothing else is wrong.

disk.name: Disk full
disk.symptom: Disk 100%. Writes failing, logs can't rotate, the replicas are stuck.

forecast.text: Disk at 85% and climbing. Clear old snapshots before it fills.
